newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Jan-Feb 1997 cap acct surplus $287.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Jan-Feb 1997 cap acct surplus $287.7 mln.

text.p: The Slovak capital account recorded a surplus of $287.7 million for the first two months of the year, compared to a $192.8 million surplus for the January-February period of 1996, the central bank said on Wednesday.
The capital account was in surplus by $209.1 million for January 1997.
The NBS has already reported that the current account posted a deficit of $221.9 million in February 1997, which increased to $478.7 million in the first quarter of this year.
CAPITAL ACCOUNT Jan-Feb 97 Jan 97 Jan-Feb 96 FY 1996
Note. All figures are in millions of U.S. dollars and subject to revision. The central bank used the following exchange rates in calculating the figures: USD=32.495 SKK
